heroContent.headline: We Craft Exceptional
heroContent.subHeading: Aquron is a full-service digital agency crafting fluid, high-performance websites, mobile apps, e-commerce, and marketing for bold brands worldwide.

aboutContent.heading: We are Aquron -- Built for the Bold
aboutContent.para1: Founded in Kolkata, India, Aquron started as a two-person studio and grew into a full-service digital agency with a global client roster. We have shipped products used by hundreds of thousands across 30+ countries.
aboutContent.para2: Like water (aqua), we adapt to every challenge -- finding the most elegant, precise path. Like Clash Royale's best players, we deploy the right strategy at the right moment.
